status.principle: A terminal state prevents a bootstrap record from posing as the evidence root.

honest_verdict.principle: The verdict must state eligibility, failed scopes, and retirement boundaries with a terminal prefix.

verdict_class.principle: A closed enum carries null, blocked, partial, and disqualified state downstream.

v569_artifact_eligibility_rows.principle: One row per expected V569 artifact makes missing and unusable evidence visible.

live_verifier_and_duration_rows.principle: Fresh commands, exits, flags, and monotonic durations resolve stale stamped findings.

gguf_admission_root_cause.principle: The next mechanism must target the observed hash-only path defect, not repeat generic fit prediction.

v570_gate_contract_rows.principle: Every downstream gate must name an in-roadmap task and exact upstream field.

prior_failure_and_retirement_rows.principle: Every scope match needs a changed mechanism and repeat-retirement rule.

model_arc_and_hardware_boundary.principle: The root freezes flagship, live-ARC, and zero-unchanged-command rules.

v570_evidence_contract_ready_score.principle: One binary field gates tasks that require the full V570 evidence contract.

rust_fusion_reopen_ready_score.principle: A separate binary field permits only the changed fused workload and freezes retirement.

per_unit_rows.principle: Artifact-level rows prevent one missing or invalid input from hiding in an aggregate.

aggregate_row_recomputation.principle: Readiness fields must derive only from emitted rows.

gate_check_summary.principle: A blocked verdict must name the failed check and observed value.

preconditions_checked.principle: Resource and input receipts distinguish missing prerequisites from evidence failure.

protected_files_unchanged.principle: The task must not mutate research-roadmap.yaml or scripts/research_conductor.py.

inference_substrate.principle: This is immutable artifact audit with no new LLM inference.

verifier_is_oracle.principle: Artifact validation is audit authority, so a clean result cannot use a positive class.

field_provenance.principle: Every headline field identifies source rows, hashes, and reducer.

duration_s.principle: Monotonic duration exposes skipped contract work.

tests_run.principle: Named commands and exit codes make the contract reproducible.

reproducibility_checksum.principle: A final content hash detects terminal-record mutation.
